Kannada is the official language of the state of Karnataka which is the location of Bangalore and the centre of India's burgeoning IT industry. 
* 3 February 2011 - A funny [[Haskell wrong channel story|story]] with wrong mailing happened on Haskell beginners mailing list.
* 5 February 2011 - A [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/lojban+(fr)&amp;no_bl=y French-language home page] was added to the Lojban web site.
* 12 February 2011 - A [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/lojban+(fi)&amp;no_bl=y Finnish version of the home page] was added to the Lojban web site. 
* 5 March 2011 - The first anniversary of the inauguration of the Japanese-language Google Group [http://groups.google.com/group/lojban-soudan "lojban-soudan"]. At the end of its first year, it had about fifteen members. There is also a Lojban Club at Osaka University, [mailto:lamuk.lalojban.nelci@gmail.com one of whose members] updated the Japanese pages of the Lojban wiki. 
* 12 April 2011 - An [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/%D9%84%D9%88%D8%AC%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%86&amp;no_bl=y Arabic version of the home page] was added to the Lojban web site. This was the last of the world's major languages (the six used for creating "gismu" - Lojban's root words) in which the home page was translated.
* July 2-3 2011 - The Lojban community's annual convention, [[jbonunsla|Logfest]] (known in Lojban as [[jbonunsla|jbonunsla]]), was held on Saturday July 2 and Sunday July 3 at the [http://www.holidayinn.com/hotels/us/en/san-mateo/sfosm/hoteldetail/directions Holiday Inn] in San Mateo, California, USA. Lojbanists from all around the country  [[jbonunsla 2011|conversed and gamed in Lojban]].
* 23 August 2011 - [http://courses.rice.edu/admweb/swkscat.main?p_action=COURSE&amp;p_crn=16915&amp;p_term=201210 "Introductory Lojban"] was offered by Joe Anderson (djandus) at [http://www.rice.edu/ Rice University] in Houston, USA as a student-run, 14 week course. Each lesson lasted 1 hour.
* 9 October 2011 - The [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/LLG+Meeting+Summary+2011 2011 annual meeting of LLG] was called to order. It was adjourned November 14.
* 1 November 2011 - Robin Lee Powell announces the birth of the "jbocifnu" twins.
* 24 November 2011 - Martin Bays announces the first release of [https://gitorious.org/tersmu tersmu], a "semantic parser" implemented in Haskell, for translating lojban to first order logic.
* The first working draft of the new textbook for newbies [[Lojban Wave Lessons Continued|Lojban Wave Lessons Continued]] was presented.

=== 2012-Present ===
IRC usage grows. [[la guskant]] and [[la selpa'i]] sing and rap in lojban. Lojban software proliferates on github. BPFK reauthorized with new charter. CLL republished in print and as e-book.

==== 2012 ====
* 26 January 2012 - [https://twitter.com/LojbanHQ/status/162634983196991488 First tweet] from LLG Twitter account.
* March - la tsani writes a paper on [[tsani's_Interpretations:_Abstractors|abstractors]] arguing (among other things) that {ka} abstractions are a better choice than {nu} in many predicate places
* 7-8 July 2012 - jbonunsla, a not-quite-annual social gathering for members of the Lojban community, [https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!topic/lojban/KtHm8qDKniM was held in San Mateo, California].
* August 26 - [[la guskant]] releases [https://vimeo.com/113181181 la crisa ditcu] on YouTube.
* September 17 - Yoshikuni Jujo released [https://hackage.haskell.org/package/lojysamban lojysamban], Prolog with Lojban.
* September 24 [[User:gleki|la gleki]] starts a new wiki [http://mw.lojban.org/ mw.lojban.org]
* October 1 - Yoshikuni Jujo released [https://hackage.haskell.org/package/cakyrespa cakyrespa], run turtle like LOGO with Lojban. ''[[The Troika Incident]]'' is released for Amazon Kindle.
* October 26 - The [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/LLG+Meeting+Summary+2012 2012 annual meeting of LLG] is called to order. It was adjourned December 11.
* December 10 - [http://ihmisentila.tumblr.com "Ihmisen tila - The Human Condition", an original play by Jyrki Pylväs] is premiered in Helsinki, Finland. It includes [http://ihmisentila.tumblr.com/post/35208355474/toinen-otto-ja-vahan-eri-meininki a monologue in lojban] translated by [[la selpa'i]].
* December 29 - [[timo]] presents [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QdlGxgKt7nc a lightning talk about lojban] at the 29th Chaos Communication C ngress, Hamburg, Germany.
* [[Fancy Generation Lojbanists]] form a unified IRC group approving of some important extensions to Lojban grammar including treating [[''ka'' versus ''du'u'', and ''ce'u'' and ''zo'e''|ce'u]] and bridi relative clause
* Lojban usage in IRC reaches new peak.
* All gismu and cmavo definitions translated to Russian and imported into jbovlaste

==== 2013 ====
* January 2 - [http://www.amazon.com/Transhumanist-Wager-Zoltan-Istvan-ebook/dp/B00AQQSY60 Zoltan Istvan's "Transhumanist Wager"], a science fiction novel which references lojban, is published.
* January 4-6 - 25th anniversary LogFest is celebrated in Fairfax, VA.
* January 22 - Ross Ogilvie publishes a paper [http://rossogilvie.id.au/essays/2013-01-22-fancu-bridi-mekso/ The Sad State of Mex] discussing mathematical part of Lojban grammar.
* February 20 - On the mailing list, v4hn introduces [[Keith Donnellan]]'s distinction between "referential" and "attributive" descriptions, and suggests a relationship with ''le'' and ''lo''.
* Wave Lessons translated to Russian
* Japanese gismu and cmavo definitions imported into jbovlaste
* April 19 - lojbab and Nora are [https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/lojban/OWqJt0hcMQY invited] to [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zg0pK-8zXA0 speak to the "Artificial Languages" class at the College of William and Mary].
* May - la cogas translates the Lojban Wave Lessons to Japanese. [[la guskant]] completes a series of [http://guskant.github.io/kolojbo.iu audio lessons in Japanese].
* May 6 - Masato Hagiwara creates his [http://mhagiwara.github.io/camxes.js/ camxes.js], a javascript parser.
* [[User:ilmen|la .ilmen.]] creates [[la ilmentufa]], a modified version of Masato Hagiwara's parser.
* June 3 - The song [[ca pa djedi]] relased becoming a hit in Lojban community.
* [[User:gleki|la gleki]] makes huge changes to the new wiki [http://mw.lojban.org/ mw.lojban.org]
* June 7 - [[la guskant]] releases «[https://vimeo.com/113232481 ro roi za'u re'u ji'a]»
* August 2 - Ben Goertzel presents "[http://youtu.be/xxsbpL_GQ9w Lojban++: An Interlingua for Communication Between Humans and AGIs]" at the Sixth Conference on Artificial General Intelligence (AGI-13) in Beijing. ([http://goertzel.org/agi-13/Lojban_paper_v1.pdf PDF])
* September - la cogas publishes an elementary lojban course in Japanese, "[http://seesaawiki.jp/hajiloji hajiloji]".
* October 4 - [[la guskant]] releases a recording of «[https://vimeo.com/113351301 la tcungatcangas pe mu sofybakni zi'e noi xorlo je xorla]», a translation of the Russian song «Tcungatcangas», including original artwork
* German definitions of gismu have been imported into jbovlaste.
* December - [[la guskant]] presents "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lzqhNYCWKLo Lojban and Quine]" in Japanese
* December 10 - Slate's" Lexicon Alley" podcast features [http://www.slate.com/articles/podcasts/lexicon_valley/2013/12/lexicon_valley_lojban_is_an_invented_language_that_aims_to_be_supremely.html an interview with Arika Okrent about lojban].
* December 24 - ''The Wonderful Wizard of Oz'' has been [http://selpahi.de/oz.html translated] to Lojban by [[User:Selpa'i|la selpa'i]] giving the largest text in Lojban in history by far.

==== 2014 ====
* January 19 - The [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/LLG+Meeting+Summary+2013 2013 annual meeting of the membership of LLG] is called to order. It was adjourned March 21. 
* French definitions of gismu earlier [http://jolapache.free.fr/lojban/gismu/g.html translated] by [mailto:jolapache@free.fr Jonathan Derque] have been checked by [[User:Pier.abat|Pierre Abbat]] allowing their import into jbovlaste.
* March - [[la guskant]] completes "[[gadri の論理学的観点からの解説]]", which she later translates into English as "[[gadri: an unofficial commentary from a logical point of view]]".
* March 5 - [[la selpa'i]] releases his second original song, «[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sLrmjRIMgAk lo mi jufra]»
* March 23 - Wu Pan translated gismu definitions to Chinese and [[User:mukti|la mukti]] imported them to jbovlaste.
* March 27 - "Simple English", a new language in jbovlaste. Simplified definitions of gismu were imported into it.
* April 5 - danr [https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/lojban/sGoK80yVNPI announces] the release of "[http://korp.alexburka.com/ korpora zei sisku]", a new corpus indexing and search system.
* June 9 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.com/2014/06/lojban-is-monoparsing.html article] arguing that monoparsing is one of the main virtues of Lojban (meaning that what in one language might be covered by a single rule (folding together the differences in two parallel sentences, for example) might in Lojban take a number of separate rules).
* June 24 - [[User:mukti|la mukti]] makes fixes to [[jbovlaste]] dictionary to match the contemporary grammar.
* July 5 - [[la guskant]] starts a Lojbanic, biweekly video podcast, "[https://vimeo.com/album/3148016 bripre jikca]".
* August - Gerold Hintz completes masters thesis, "[https://www.lt.informatik.tu-darmstadt.de/fileadmin/user_upload/Group_LangTech/student_theses/_Semantic_parsing_using_Lojban_-_On_the_middle_ground_between_semantic_ontology_and_language.pdf Semantic parsing using lojban - On the middle ground between semantic ontology and language]" at TU Darmstadt (there is [[File:FN-mappings.zip|unofficial complementary stuff]] for the thesis).
* October 6 - [[la selpa'i]] releases another rap song, this time featuring lyrics by various Lojbanists (danr, Ilmen, durka), «[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N-Y9eBBTrxU LO JBOBAU CU MO]»
* October 20 - on BBC radio [[User:Robin Lee Powell|Robin Lee Powell]] [http://www.bbc.co.uk/programmes/b04lpxx9 tells] about communicating with his young daughters using Lojban, and how he tests the creative boundaries of a purely logical language. In the same show [[Arika Okrent]] tells the story of the divide between Loglan and Lojban.
* The mw.lojban.org wiki has a lot of improvements, it posts its changes to Twitter and Facebook.
* November - Patrik Austin, a Finnish Esperantist, publishes "[http://ling.auf.net/lingbuzz/002272 Predicate logic is a suboptimal basis for real time logical language]" in [http://ling.auf.net/lingbuzz LingBuzz], an online linguistics forum.
* November 11 - an autoupdating version of la sutsis made [https://lojban.github.io/sutysisku/index.html#sisku/badna available]. Try opening this address from Chrome (desktop or mobile versions) after you lose connection to the internet. It will still work.
* December 15 - [[la tsani]], la durka, la mukti, [[la guskant]], lai az, [[la selpa'i]], la xalbo, la ilmen and [[la gleki]] become members of [[LLG]]. Veio and la broca leave the Board of Directors of LLG. John Cowan leaves LLG (on various reasons including the abundance of members at this time).

==== 2015 ====
* January - More versions of la sutsis are rolled out: for [https://lojban.github.io/sutysisku/jbo/index.html purely Lojban dictionary], for [https://lojban.github.io/sutysisku/ja/index.html Japanese dictionary], for [https://lojban.github.io/sutysisku/fr-facile/index.html Facile French], for [https://lojban.github.io/sutysisku/eo/index.html Esperanto].
* January 10 - Arkadii Balandin, Craig B. Daniel, Ali Sajid Imani, Riley Martinez-Lynch, and And Rosta were elected to the LLG Board of Directors. Robert LeChevalier and Timo Paulssen were re-elected.
* January 13 -  John Cowan was awarded the honorary title of "Archgrammarian" or "balgenpre" in recognition of the magnitude of his contributions to Lojban, and his many years as a member, director and officer of LLG.
* February 21 - Dutch animator [https://twitter.com/Benimation Benimation] releases [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D9mQGdvmFUc a cover of «crisa ditcu»], a song by [[la guskant]]. The vocals are software-generated.
* February 24 -  LLG Members at the 2014 Annual Meeting approved a [[BPFK Reauthorization|reauthorization of BPFK]].
* March 16 - Lojban becomes the first constructed language fully supported by [https://vivaldi.net/en-US/blogs/teamblog/item/15-weekly-snapshot-1-0-129-2 Vivaldi web browser].
* March 30 - The Lojbanic MediaWiki is promoted to become new main lojban.org web site.
* April 23 - [[Image:La Muplis.png|link=|96px]] [https://lojban.github.io/sutysisku/muplis/index.html#search/gleki La Muplis], a modified version of la sutsis for Tatoeba.org database is published by [[la gleki]]. The advantage over pure search on [http://tatoeba.org tatoeba.org] is speed and that it's bound to Lojban only.
* June 1 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.de/2015/06/the-role-of-errors-in-history-of.html article] discussing whether Loglan and Lojban are spoken logic.
* June 4 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.de/2015/06/the-role-of-errors-in-history-of_4.html article] discussing how prenex is constructed in Lojban and how sentences with it are related to formal logic.
* June 6 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.com/2015/06/the-role-of-errors-in-history-of_6.html article] discussing how in Loglan and Lojban conjunctions are construted and how they reflect formal logic.
* June 9 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.com/2015/06/the-role-of-errors-in-history-of_26.html article] discussing how Loglan and Lojban were designed to test the Sapir-Whorf Hypothesis.
* June 9 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.com/2015/06/the-role-of-errors-in-history-of_26.html article] discussing whether Loglan and Lojban are culturally neutral.
* June 17 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.com/2015/06/the-role-of-errors-in-history-of_17.html article] discussing whether Loglan and Lojban increase rationality.
* June 21 - la djemynai publishes «[https://djemynai.bandcamp.com/album/zao ZA'O]», a full-length rap album of songs in lojban.
* June 28 - The LLG Board of Directors re-elected Robert Lechavalier as President, electing And Rosta as Vice President and Riley Martinez-Lynch as Secretary/Treasurer.
*August 28 - [[la pycyn]] publishes an [http://pckipo.blogspot.com/2015/08/the-role-of-errors-in-history-of.html article "Maxim 4: Loglans are unambiguous."] arguing that Lojban and Loglan are not derived systematically from [[First Order Predicate Logic|FOPL and its extensions]].
* August 28-30 - [[jbonunsla 2015]] is celebrated in Princeton, New Jersey.
*October 4 - [[John Cowan]] [https://youtu.be/lxQjwbUiM9w reads] an extract from ''Alice in  Wonderland'' for [https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCBgWgQyEb5eTzvh4lLcuipQ Wikitongues].
*October 8 - [[la epkat]] makes a new instant messaging place, https://lojban.slack.com
*October 9 - https://lojban.slack.com becomes fully synchronized with Lojban IRC chat thus solving a long standing issue of IRC not being user friendly to many people and not saving history of messages.
*October 10 - Benjamin Gregory Carlisle [http://www.bgcarlisle.com/blog/2015/10/05/lojban-logical-connectives-illustrated-with-venn-diagrams/ prepares] a [[:File:Truth-functions.pdf|cheatsheet]] of Lojban logical connectives illustrated with Venn diagrams.
*December 13 - la gleki installs a [[Lojban IRC]] <=> "Telegram instant messenger" gateway (after enabling a gateway to/from Slack messenger earlier) and in the light of these technically easy but important for the Lojban community achievements [https://groups.google.com/d/topic/lojban/ng0WbJ11RzU/discussion declares] the end of The Era of Lojban IRC Detachment.
*December 26 - Masato Hagiwara [https://groups.google.com/d/topic/lojban/6HQo135bO8I/discussion announces] a statistical based machine translation from English into Lojban and vice versa.

==== 2016 ====
*February 29 - [http://minecraft.gamepedia.com/1.9 Minecraft 1.9] is released, which includes a community-created Lojban translation.
* April 13 - "[[The Complete Lojban Language]]" is republished in hardcover and Kindle e-book format.
* June 1 - [[la selpa'i]] publishes [http://selpahi.weebly.com/jbo/mi-zaho-citno lu mi za'o citno li'u], an original short story in lojban.
* November 12 - [[la guskant]] publishes [https://vimeo.com/190637628 lo vliraitru], an animated documentary in lojban.
* December 7 - [http://youtu.be/KA_s8B9xJBU 'Lojban as an Interlingua'] lecture by Ben Goertzel and Ruiting Lian at OpenCog's 'Hong Cogathon Dec 2016'.

==== 2018 ====

*September - la gleki adds [https://mw.lojban.org/papri/Lojban_Live_Chat Mattermost, Facebook messenger] and vk.com board integration to the live chat that is synchronized between those messengers as well as to Telegram, Slack and IRC (synchronization of which was deployed in 2015).

==== 2020 ====

* January - [[la gleki]] starts a [https://lojban.pw/articles/complete-lojban-language/ series of unofficial regular updates] to the [[Complete Lojban Language]] book mostly fixing mistypes and contradictions in the book.
* March 4 - a new channel for French speakers gets opened, immediately gets significant activity and gets bridged between Telegram, Discord, Slack, IRC networks ([https://lojban.pw/articles/live_chat/ links])

* June - la [[zbalermorna]] orthography gets into the unofficial release of the 'Complete Lojban Language' book.
* June - [[la sutysisku]] app now has playable audio for definitions of many words and has visual clues to the structure of [[lujvo]] and words having 'property' places.
* July 13 - la korvo breaks ground on [[brismu|la brismu]] ([https://groups.google.com/g/lojban/c/L8NFx18ZePc/m/y6P-WAMbAgAJ announcement])

==== 2023 ====

* August 1 - la brismu formalizes 1% of baseline; la korvo projects that 40% of baseline valsi can be formalized ([https://groups.google.com/g/lojban/c/AVnd42r-0JQ/m/Wro74oo5AQAJ announcement])

==== 2024 ====

* April 2 - la brismu formalizes 3% of baseline and ontologizes another 12%; la korvo requests that LFK meet and consider some issues raised by the formalization process ([https://groups.google.com/g/lojban/c/g9kp6R8kEU4/m/OkVwxmlOAwAJ announcement])
